events.event: Ombudsman investigation closed; found excessive delay (11 months after new information), poor communication and inadequate records; did not find DVLA obliged to follow applicant's doctors or allow driving assessment.

Ombudsman investigation closed; found deficient communication but did not substantiate claims of contacting wrong consultant or lacking consent. Ombudsman recommended apology and £200 payment; agency complied with recommendations.

methodology: No causal inference. No guilt inference. Counts are administrative workflows, not population prevalence. 545/75% is not a ratio of 9,692 investigations. FY2024-25 corresponds to 2024-04-01 through 2025-03-31. Source 2024-25 annual report OGL v3 except where stated; website permissions not generalized.
